summary: Implements storage-location confinement using only the standard library. LocationPolicy (frozen) holds a local root, a per-scheme allow-list of remote hosts or buckets, and an allow_unconfined opt-out; LocationNotAllowed is a StorageError whose message redacts URL userinfo. Module functions classify a location's scheme, decode file:// URIs, confine local paths to the root after resolving symlinks and '..', optionally verify a directory tree stays inside the root, and check remote hosts against the allow-list or a profile's own host.
key_classes: LocationPolicy(root=None, allowed_remote={}, allow_unconfined=False) — frozen confinement policy passed to StorageFacade/from_path/for_local
LocationNotAllowed(location, reason) — StorageError with redacted .location and .reason
key_functions: LocationPolicy.with_declared_root(declared) -> LocationPolicy — use a profile-declared root (e.g. LocalStorageProfile.ROOT_PATH) only when the policy sets none
identify_scheme(location) -> str | None — canonical scheme ('' for local, Windows drive/UNC paths local), None if unknown
local_path(location) -> str — decode a file:// URI to an absolute path; reject non-local hosts, query or fragment
url_host(location) -> str — IDNA-normalised lowercase host; LocationNotAllowed if unparsable
require_known_scheme(location, policy) -> str | None — identify scheme; with an active policy, unknown schemes and parse errors raise a sanitised LocationNotAllowed
confine_local(location, policy, *, tree=False) -> str — resolve the path under policy.root; raise if outside; tree=True also checks every directory entry
allow_remote(scheme, host, policy, *, profile_host=None) -> None — permit if host equals profile_host or is in allowed_remote[scheme]; otherwise raise
extension_points: Backends call allow_remote/url_host for their own host checks (SFTP helpers do) so per-request enforcement, including redirects, is consistent
lifecycle_notes: Stdlib-only import is a tested invariant (tests/test_lazy_imports.py::test_location_module_import_is_stdlib_only); not re-exported from the package root
With policy=None or allow_unconfined=True every check is a no-op apart from scheme identification and file:// decoding
Facade construction composes the caller policy with a local profile's declared ROOT_PATH via with_declared_root
Paths that do not yet exist are resolved component-wise so writes under the root are permitted while '..' in a missing remainder is rejected
documentation_hooks: README 'Location policy' section and a dedicated security/confinement guide: root confinement, allow-lists, profile permission, unconfined opt-out
Threat-model limits: host-name checks only (no DNS-rebinding defence); managed-OAuth token endpoints not covered
Proof point for broader positioning: deny-by-default remote access with per-request (including redirect) checks on a stdlib-only module
risks: An empty frozenset in allowed_remote permits every host for that scheme (allow_remote returns when 'not entries'); tests rely on this, but README describes allowed_remote only as a host list, so a caller writing frozenset() to mean 'none' gets 'any'
Confinement is a check-then-use on resolved paths; symlinks changed between check and I/O are not defended (TOCTOU), and DNS rebinding is out of scope (README limits)
_check_tree walks the whole directory tree with followlinks=True, which can be expensive on large trees
No runnable example in examples/ demonstrates LocationPolicy
Windows drive/UNC handling is flagged in code as not CI-verified
open_questions: Is 'empty frozenset means any host for this scheme' the intended public semantics? If so it should be documented in README; if not, allow_remote and tests need changing.
Should LocationPolicy have a runnable recipe in examples/ given its doc_priority?
